origin.3003.zh: 生命之树所在星球受到严重轰炸后：生命之树被毁
origin.3003.en: When a planet with the Tree of Life is devastated: Life-Tree Destroyed

opening.evidence: on_planet_bombarded common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2170 fires carrier event origin.3003 when planet_devastation >= 50 on a planet with d_tree_of_life_colony / d_tree_of_life_home (events/origin_events_3.txt:52-83). Hidden 3001 (on_colonized :1309) adds the tree to new colonies, 3002 (:1343, :3377) silently removes it, 3004 (:3378) maintains the no_lifetree modifier.

uncertain: Hidden 3001/3002/3004 only add or remove deposits and modifiers.
